name: Remix: Pragmatic Lexicon
description: Pragmatic Lexicon is a high-performance vocabulary and active-recall flashcard learning app tailored for software engineers, journalists, and professionals. Features 1,445+ curated terms across letters A–Z spanning software engineering, AI systems, broadcast journalism, biblical theology, church fellowship, and trending US/UK/Scottish vocabulary with dual English and Tamil context examples for every entry, comprehensive thesaurus explore, British English pronunciation, vertical fast-navigation scrubber, and interactive 3D study cards.
